# Are your Upwork Connects paying for themselves?

> Free calculator for freelancers: what your Connects and proposal-writing time cost per hire, the win rate you need to break even, and the most Connects a proposal can spend before it loses money. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
